items.title: Listen Labs raises $69M after viral billboard hiring stunt to scale AI customer interviews
items.summary: Alfred Wahlforss was running out of options. His startup, Listen Labs , needed to hire over 100 engineers, but competing against Mark Zuckerberg's $100 million offers seemed impossible. So he spent $5,000 — a fifth of his marketing budget — on a billboard in San Francisco displaying what looked like gibberish: five strings of random numbers. The numbers were actually AI tokens. Decoded, they led to a coding challenge
items.summaryZh: Listen Labs通过创意的招聘广告获得6900万美元融资，旨在利用AI进行客户访谈。该报道侧重于商业融资与营销策略，而非AI模型技术的突破。

items.title: D4RT: Teaching AI to see the world in four dimensions
items.summary: D4RT: Unified, efficient 4D reconstruction and tracking up to 300x faster than prior methods.
items.summaryZh: Google DeepMind发布了D4RT（动态4D重建与追踪）模型，旨在解决从2D视频中恢复动态3D场景的复杂问题。该模型通过统一的框架，将动态场景的重建与追踪效率提升至传统方法的300倍。D4RT能够有效解耦相机运动与物体运动，在处理遮挡和复杂时空关系方面表现出色，为机器感知动态现实世界提供了新的技术路径。

aiReview.reasonZh: Google DeepMind推出的D4RT模型在动态场景重建与追踪领域实现了显著的效率提升。

items.title: Our approach to advertising and expanding access to ChatGPT
items.summary: OpenAI plans to test advertising in the U.S. for ChatGPT’s free and Go tiers to expand affordable access to AI worldwide, while protecting privacy, trust, and answer quality.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI宣布计划在美国市场为ChatGPT的免费版及Go版引入广告测试。此举旨在通过商业化手段降低全球用户获取先进AI服务的门槛，同时承诺在广告投放过程中严格保护用户隐私、维护信任度并确保回答质量。这是OpenAI在平衡商业可持续性与普惠AI愿景方面的重要战略调整。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI引入广告模式以扩大ChatGPT免费及Go层级的覆盖范围，具有重要的商业战略意义。

items.title: Introducing ChatGPT Go, now available worldwide
items.summary: ChatGPT Go is now available worldwide, offering expanded access to GPT-5.2 Instant, higher usage limits, and longer memory—making advanced AI more affordable globally.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI正式在全球范围内推出ChatGPT Go服务。该版本集成了最新的GPT-5.2 Instant模型，旨在通过优化推理速度与成本，为全球用户提供更高效的AI体验。ChatGPT Go不仅提升了使用限额，还引入了更长的上下文记忆功能，进一步降低了高级AI工具的使用门槛，是OpenAI推动AI普及化进程中的关键产品更新。

aiReview.reasonZh: ChatGPT Go的全球发布标志着GPT-5.2 Instant模型的大规模落地，显著提升了AI服务的可及性。
